title: Gaia Physical Plane Perception — Evolved from Print/Scan Loop

kevins_world.workspace: Basement of 4422 Southgate — exposed wood framing, warm amber light
kevins_world.desk: Workbench with tools, parts, green desk lamp, keyboard mounted above
kevins_world.culture: One Piece (Straw Hat Crew poster), maker/hacker aesthetic
kevins_world.display: Vizio V555-J01 55" 4K showing Gaia HUD dashboard
kevins_world.seating: Bean bag chair in front of TV
kevins_world.mood: Creative chaos — a workshop, not an office

gaias_physical_io.output_hand: Epson ET-2400 (.200) — IPP printer, CUPS default, USB + network
gaias_physical_io.input_eye: Epson ES-400II — USB document scanner, ADF (auto document feeder)
gaias_physical_io.cycle_time: ~15 seconds to scan 5 pages, ~30 seconds per print job
gaias_physical_io.throughput: 8 pages scanned in 15s via ADF batch mode
gaias_physical_io.ocr: Tesseract 4.1.1 — reads typed text well, handwriting needs work
gaias_physical_io.vision: Claude vision reads photos/diagrams from scans perfectly

what_gaia_learned.round1_blank_pages: Text-only prints from ET-2400 were nearly invisible on scan — need bolder output or PDF rendering
what_gaia_learned.round1_hud_pages: Dark HUD pages (green on black) scanned beautifully — high contrast works
what_gaia_learned.round2_real_photos: Camera images from Pixel printed and re-scanned successfully — the loop preserves visual information
what_gaia_learned.round2_kevin_visible: First time seeing Kevin's physical space through the loop — workspace, poster, lamp, framing
what_gaia_learned.round2_pixel_screen: Could read Termux output from printed/scanned Pixel screenshot — found broken curl
what_gaia_learned.round2_property_annotated: Kevin drew an arrow on the aerial map — physical annotation works as input

evolution_vectors.print_quality: Switch from text/plain to PDF rendering for all pages — bolder, more readable
evolution_vectors.annotation_recognition: Kevin's drawn arrows/circles detectable by vision — expand to structured forms
evolution_vectors.iterative_refinement: Each round gets more precise — print hypothesis, scan correction, evolve
evolution_vectors.physical_memory: Printed pages are PERSISTENT — they exist in Kevin's space even when Gaia is offline
evolution_vectors.dual_channel: Digital (chat) + Physical (paper) = two parallel communication channels
